name: io.github.dockndevai/mcp-mac-control
description: Full macOS control — drive a Mac like a human: shell, AppleScript, files, and human-like GUI.

environmentVariables.name: MACCTL_SAFE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Set true to invert to safe-by-default: read-only, all powers gated, confirmations on. Default false (full control).

environmentVariables.name: MACCTL_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Access mode: read-only | read-write | admin. Defaults to admin (or read-only in safe mode).

environmentVariables.name: MACCTL_CONFIRM
environmentVariables.description: Set true to require human approval (via MCP elicitation) on destructive ops. Default off in full control.

environmentVariables.name: MACCTL_PATH_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated path roots the agent may touch (empty = anywhere).

environmentVariables.name: MACCTL_PROTECTED_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated path roots that may be read but never modified/deleted (empty by default in full control).
